decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed sitting and appearance of the development is considered to represent an inappropriate and obtrsive feature in the locality, the effect of which would unduly impact on the visual and residential amenity in the area, particularly having regard to conerns which have been expressed about the potential detriment to health by emissions from telecommunications apparatus of the kind proposed. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV.1.1 and ENV.1.12 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan; policies ENV.B.1.1 and ENV.1.17 of the Review Deposit Unitary Development Plan and Planning Policy Guidance Note 8: Telecommunication.
description: Replacement of the three existing antennae with 3 modern types of similar appearance, adding 1 transmission dish and swapping the current equipment cabin/or another of similar size and appearance save for the addition of heat management units on the rear wall.
